summary: Adds question create, list, update and confirmed delete with stable identity and durable saves before in-memory publication.

Uses candidate snapshots, cooperating file locks, stale-byte comparisons and atomic replacement; a versioned UTF-8/Base64 format supports special text and valid empty banks while preserving legacy read compatibility.
Strengthens domain immutability, duplicate-ID and answer validation, whole-file corruption handling and the supported A-Z choice range.
Handles EOF during forms and quizzes without partial mutation or crashes; partial results distinguish answered and unanswered questions.
Adds a JDK 17 test runner, 28 regression cases, nine separate-process checks including competing JVM saves, and nine detailed CRUD upskilling documents.

checks.command: run.ps1 -Test; nine process scenarios via verify_j4.py, including two gated JVM writers and persisted CLI reloads
checks.environment: Microsoft OpenJDK 17.0.10; --release 17 -Xlint:all; real temporary files and separate JVM processes

limits: Local CLI and file storage; no HTTP, browser, SQL database, authentication or persisted quiz-attempt history.
Sidecar locks coordinate cooperating writers; non-cooperating external editors, network filesystems and power-loss durability are outside verification.
First accepted edit converts legacy data to the versioned format; older binaries cannot read it. Original example data was not modified.
Startup failures are reported in text without a distinct nonzero application exit status.
